modmenu.descriptionTranslation.velocity-: Velocity-biased anisotropic chunk meshing and predictive forward chunk generation for fast travelers.
velocityrender.gamerule.enabled.descript: Master switch to enable velocity-biased chunk meshing on client and predictive generation on server.
Scales how far ahead along travel vector chunk loading tickets are requested (0% to 300%).
velocityrender.gamerule.budget_conservat: Dynamically trims lateral/rear non-simulation tickets during high speeds to protect server TPS.
velocityrender.gamerule.min_speed_thresh: Minimum velocity in hundredths of a block/tick required before activating forward bias (e.g. 20 = 0.20 b/t).
velocityrender.gamerule.debug_mode.descr: Logs real-time vector diagnostics, ticket counts, and MSPT adjustments to server console.
velocityrender.gamerule.turn_widening.de: Dynamically widens chunk generation corridor during sharp turns to prevent outer-curve void pop-in.
velocityrender.gamerule.vertical_lookahe: Incorporate vertical pitch velocity into chunk meshing and altitude corridor updates during dives and climbs.
velocityrender.gamerule.server_ticket_bu: Maximum total active forward loading tickets allocated server-wide across all concurrent flyers.
velocityrender.gamerule.f3_debug.descrip: Display Velocity Render engine telemetry on Minecraft F3 debug screen.
velocityrender.gamerule.nether_reach_cla: Forward lookahead corridor reach percentage in the Nether (10% to 100%).
velocityrender.gamerule.default_dense_re: Forward lookahead corridor reach percentage in non-Overworld or dense modded dimensions (10% to 100%).
velocityrender.gamerule.lod_trajectory_h: Broadcasts forward velocity trajectory to Distant Horizons and Bobby to prioritize distant terrain loading.
velocityrender.command.reload.success: [Velocity Render] Configuration and GameRules reloaded successfully.
velocityrender.command.reset.success: [Velocity Render] All settings restored to vanilla defaults.
config.velocityrender.title: Velocity Render Settings
config.velocityrender.enabled.descriptio: Master switch to enable velocity-biased chunk meshing on the client and predictive generation on the server. Default: Enabled.
config.velocityrender.leadMultiplier.des: Scales how far ahead along your velocity vector chunk loading tickets and meshing reach. Default: 100%. Higher values look farther ahead at higher CPU cost.
config.velocityrender.minSpeedThresholdP: Minimum velocity in hundredths of a block/tick required before activating forward bias (20 = 0.20 b/t or 4.0 m/s). Default: 20.
config.velocityrender.turnWidening.descr: Dynamically widens the forward chunk generation corridor during sharp Elytra banked turns to eliminate void gaps. Default: Enabled.
Incorporate vertical pitch velocity into chunk meshing and altitude corridor updates during dives and climbs. Default: Enabled.
config.velocityrender.serverTicketBudget: Maximum total active forward loading tickets allocated server-wide across all concurrent flyers. Default: 64 tickets.
config.velocityrender.netherReachClampPc: Forward lookahead corridor reach percentage in the Nether (10% to 100%) to prevent heavy 3D carver worldgen lag. Default: 60%.
config.velocityrender.defaultDenseReachC: Forward lookahead corridor reach percentage in non-Overworld or dense modded dimensions (10% to 100%). Default: 80%.
config.velocityrender.lodTrajectoryHooks: Broadcasts forward velocity trajectory to Distant Horizons and Bobby to accelerate distant terrain generation. Default: Enabled.
config.velocityrender.f3Debug.descriptio: Display Velocity Render engine telemetry on the Minecraft F3 debug screen. Default: Enabled.
config.velocityrender.debugMode.descript: Outputs detailed vector calculations and tick updates to the developer game log. Default: Disabled.
